history.summary: Freehold 4BR at Artisan 8, a tiny 34-unit (+8 shop) freehold mixed-use new launch at 8 Sin Ming Rd, 280m from Upper Thomson MRT (TOP ~2028). Priced at $3.0M / $2285 PSF, below the $2,340-2,610 launch range — but a 34-unit boutique means very thin resale liquidity, the binding constraint for a $3M unit.
history.rating_rationale: Genuine positives: freehold tenure (rare in D20 new launches), 280m to Upper Thomson MRT (TEL) plus Marymount CCL, MacRitchie/Thomson Plaza amenities, and $2285 PSF is below the launch range. But only 34 residential units = a structurally shallow secondary market, and at $3.0M the 4BR sits above the liquid band with a narrow buyer pool. The 20-txn URA figure carries new-launch bias (district-pooled), so the 4.1% isn't a clean read. Strong location, but boutique illiquidity caps it at Neutral.
red_flags: Only 34 residential units — structurally thin resale liquidity for a $3M unit
$3.0M 4BR sits above the liquid sweet spot — narrow buyer pool
URA data flagged with new-launch bias (district-pooled, 20 txns) — appreciation not cleanly verified
Mixed-use with retail below can mean higher footfall/noise and broader maintenance scope
catalysts: Freehold tenure — scarce in D20; the prior comparable freehold launch was 183 Longhaus (2016)
280m to Upper Thomson MRT (TEL) + Marymount (CCL) — dual-line walkable connectivity
Upper Thomson/Sin Ming lifestyle, MacRitchie Reservoir, Thomson Plaza — durable owner-occupier appeal
